entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6756148659453907200: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0088 +/- 0.0203 mas (same row, RUWE 0.83): 199.65 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -16.683, -31.970 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.285 +/- 0.051 solar radii from Turner et al. 2016, the stellar radius of WASP-123 b's parameter set from Turner et al. 2016 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract). Mass 1.166 +/- 0.061 solar masses from Turner et al. 2016, the stellar mass of WASP-123 b's parameter set from Turner et al. 2016 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016PASP..128f4401T/abstract). Temperature 5740 +/- 130 K from Turner et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of WASP-123 b's parameter set from Turner et al. 2016 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,740 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff0e9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,740 K and log g 4.29 (u1 0.464, u2 0.257): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
